result.summary: The page is generally well composed, but horizontal content is visibly clipped on the right and the bottom navigation intrudes over scrollable restaurant content.

issues.description: The horizontal category row extends beyond the right edge, leaving a partially visible next category chip with no clear end padding or indication that the row can scroll.
issues.suggestion: Implement a deliberate horizontally scrollable carousel with consistent right inset, or constrain/reflow the category chips so they do not appear accidentally cut off.

issues.description: The "Fastest near you" restaurant carousel is clipped at the right edge: the third card's image, title ("Trattoria Piccol…"), and delivery text are truncated by the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Use a horizontal carousel with intentional peeking, adequate trailing padding, and card widths that keep labels readable; alternatively avoid showing partially cut-off text.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the scrolling feed, obscuring the lower portion of the next restaurant card instead of reserving safe bottom space.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content padding equal to the navigation bar height plus safe-area inset so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.
